scope: Next milestone investigation; no claim that indexed seeking is fixed.
required_control_behavior: Preserve strict retained-PCM seeking and expose reference behavior explicitly.
Implement exact page-anchor bisection with CHUNKSIZE 65536, strict granule < target, last-link end bound at final page start, first-page fallback, and continued-packet/raw-seek fallback.
Reset container packet numbering relative to the selected anchor, discarding all packets before its granule-carrying packet; that marked packet can be non-audio.

An unavailable initial continuation is skipped without incrementing libogg packetno. Relative numbering starts at the first fully available packet; actual sequence holes increment packetno when the hole marker is consumed.
Preroll uses header-only declared block sizes, conservative (thisblock+maxlong)/4 threshold, track-only insertion and trust in marked granules.
Restart preserves the previous block size and PCM backing buffer; new context/link clears both.
Run real synthesis/discard until the signed file PCM cursor reaches the requested position; EOF sets declared total. A seek may return an overshot position and fewer samples, matching C.
For fetched known non-EOS granules, subtract first-offset only in links after the first, preserving pinned first-link broadcast behavior.
Do not replace file PCM cursor with SynthesisDecoder consumed-frame position or infer emitted sample counts from declared duration.
Validate repeated/backward seeks, partial reads, all 172 inventory requests, matched controls, broadcast/trim offsets, continuation pages, chains and historical files.
Investigate actual negative signed read requests or rejected track prefixes if observed; public nonnegative raw synthesis tests do not establish coverage of those C call sequences.
current_production_state: New raw SynthesisDecoder matches captured DSP schedules. OggSeekReader still uses its preexisting timing/preroll model.
